server.name: io.github.oscardvs/zoteus
server.description: The everything Zotero MCP server — Web API v3 + local API, safe writes, citations, search.

environmentVariables.description: Zotero API key (writes/sync/groups; optional for local-only reads).
environmentVariables.name: ZOTERO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Use the Zotero desktop local API: auto | on | off.
environmentVariables.name: ZOTEUS_LOCAL

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable permanent deletion (off by default).
environmentVariables.name: ZOTEUS_ALLOW_DELETE
